info.title: SIMK — Sistem Informasi & Manajemen Klinik API
info.description:
Contract-first API for the clinic information & management system.
Domain models are aligned with Indonesia SatuSehat (HL7 FHIR R4).

RequestID.name: x-request-id
RequestID.description: Request identity for logs and tracing

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description:
Current resource `version` for optimistic locking. The update is rejected
with `412` when it does not match the stored version.

Conflict.description: Conflict with the current resource state

Patient.description:
Patient registry entry. Mirrors the minimal set of FHIR R4 `Patient`
fields required by SatuSehat.

identifier.description: NIK (Nomor Induk Kependudukan) or SatuSehat IHS number.

UpdatePatient.description:
Editable patient demographics. The `identifier` (NIK) is immutable after
creation and must not be sent here.

isSystem.description: System roles are seeded and cannot be deleted or have their permissions reduced.

roleId.description: Reference to the Role to assign to the user.
Reference to the Role to assign to the user.

visitId.description: Reference to the `Visit` once the queue reaches service (nullable).

version.description: Optimistic-locking version; bump on every update.

patientId.description: Reference to the patient to enqueue.

status.description:
Next state per the queue state machine
(`waiting → in-service → done`; `waiting`/`in-service → cancelled`).

Visit.description:
A patient's clinical visit. Anchors queues, observations, and clinical
records. Mapped to FHIR R4 `Encounter`.

class.description: FHIR R4 `Encounter.class` code (e.g. AMB, EMER, IMP).

FollowUpVisit.description: Scheduled return visit for a patient. Mapped to FHIR R4 `Appointment`.

date.description: Scheduled date and time of the return visit.

Observation.description:
Clinical measurement (vital sign, lab result) anchored to a Visit.
Mapped to FHIR R4 `Observation`.

status.description:
`preliminary → final → amended`; any non-terminal state → `cancelled`
or `entered-in-error`.

version.description: Optimistic-locking version; bump on every update.

UpdateObservation.description:
Editable observation fields. `status` is changed through the dedicated
status-transition endpoint instead.

status.description:
Next state per the observation state machine
(`preliminary → final → amended`; non-terminal → `cancelled` or
`entered-in-error`).

Condition.description: Diagnosis record attached to a patient visit. Mapped to FHIR R4 `Condition`.

code.description: Diagnosis code chosen from the condition reference list.
Diagnosis code chosen from the condition reference list.

Procedure.description:
Performed-procedure record attached to a patient visit. Mapped to FHIR R4
`Procedure`.

code.description: Procedure code chosen from the procedure reference list.
Procedure code chosen from the procedure reference list.

Product.description:
Catalog item managed by the logistic admin. Mapped to FHIR R4
`Medication` / `Device`.

unit.description: Unit of measure (e.g. tablet, strip, box).

Manufacturer.description: Maker of a product. Mapped to FHIR R4 `Organization`.

Manufacturer is still referenced by a product

parameters.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

System role cannot be deleted / role still assigned to users
